items.title: Arthur "Monk" Hazel Interview, 1959-07-16
items.q: That's, as far as I, I didn't know any, anybody. Well he did, some things he took off Snoozer. Yeah. Cause he and Snoozer were good friends.

ctx.x: He had, Bill stole it from the Library of Congress now. He had the whole locker, and it was for a military band. It wasn't for, wasn't no, it was for, it was for a military band. It's, I don't know how many parts of that. But he had the whole, the whole thing, the whole orchestration. And he stole it while he was with, playing in Washington with Naylor. That's why I, every, every time I hear, they say pico originator thing, I gotta laugh, you know. Cause I saw the, I saw the thing with my own eyes, which is…
I was wondering about Joe Coffero's style on guitar. Where did he get that?

That's, as far as I, I didn't know any, anybody. Well he did, some things he took off Snoozer. Yeah. Cause he and Snoozer were good friends. See when I had the band at the roof, Snoozer used to come up there and sit with us, whenever he was in town, you see. He'd come up there and sit there with us and play guitar and fiddle, you know. That scratchy fiddle. You ever hear him play fiddle? Never did. Oh man, you ain't heard nothing. You ain't like they say, you ain't heard nothing until you heard Snoozer play fiddle.
